 Local News State News PennDOT Driver’s License, Photo Centers to Close for Veterans Day
 All PennDOT driver’s license and photo centers will be closed Wednesday, November 11, while online services will remain available.
 Brock Jordan
 Published November 8, 2026 10:00 am Driver's License Centers
 Holiday Closures
 penndot
 Pennsylvania
 veterans day
 HARRISBURG, Pa. (EYT) — The Pennsylvania Department of Transportation (PennDOT) announced that all driver’s license and photo centers across the Commonwealth will be closed on Wednesday, November 11, in observance of Veterans Day. 
 The closure includes PennDOT’s full-service center in Harrisburg, along with driver’s license and photo centers throughout Pennsylvania.
 Although in-person services will be unavailable at those locations during the holiday, PennDOT reminded residents that many driver and vehicle services can still be completed online.
 Through PennDOT’s Driver and Vehicle Services website, customers can renew driver’s licenses, photo identification cards, and vehicle registrations, as well as request duplicate licenses and identification cards.
 Other available services include address changes, driver history requests, driver exam scheduling, REAL ID pre-verification, and access to driver’s license and vehicle registration restoration letters.
 Residents can also pay driver’s license or vehicle insurance restoration fees online.
 PennDOT’s online services are available 24 hours a day, seven days a week, with no additional fees for using the online system.
 Customers can also access driver training manuals, publications and forms through the website.
 A complete list of PennDOT driver’s license and photo center holiday closures is available through the department’s website.
 PennDOT advised residents planning to visit an Online Messenger Service Center to call ahead, as holiday operating hours may vary by location.
